name: "HNP_880209_3378194" PSR
rationale: Permanently shadowed region (PGDA product 90). No published distance supports a PSR buffer; NASA OTPS (2022) says no distance can eliminate ejecta impacts entirely. The stand-off is a user parameter defaulting to 2.0 km, the NASA 2011 heritage landing stand-off applied by analogy, with the 1.5 km Apollo rock-ejecta range as a secondary ring. Neither is a PSR-protection standard. Cold-trap fraction: Diviner annual maximum below 110 K; a cold trap is not detected ice.

sources.label: PGDA product 90, A New View of the Lunar South Pole from LOLA (Barker et al. 2023, PSJ 4:183, doi:10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1; data doi:10.60903/gsfcpgda-lola-spole)
Diviner Polar Resource Product, south (Paige et al. 2010, Science, doi:10.1126/science.1187726; LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0)
NASA (2011, Rev A 28 Oct 2011), Recommendations to Space-Faring Entities: How to Protect and Preserve the Historic and Scientific Value of U.S. Government Lunar Artifacts
NASA OTPS, Lunar Landing and Operations Policy Analysis (30 Sep 2022)

buffer.label: NASA 2011 heritage landing stand-off, applied by analogy (not a PSR-protection standard)
